description: One term loan (company code 1000, product 22A) taken through create -> settle -> post -> TPM44 accrual/deferral -> TPM1 valuation, at the first month-end key date after the term start.
authorised: Values supplied by the requester on 2026-08-18. Three were not, and were decided at run time: (1) Contract Date - SAP defaults it to today and hard-refuses a save where it is after Term Start (same trap TC-002 hit), so it was set to the term start. (2) 'General Valuation Class: short term' as a key - resolved to the deal screen's own dropdown option 'Short Term' (Administr. tab) and, separately, to TPM44/TPM1's coded selection filter Valuation Area 001 / Valuation Class 0005 ('Short Term'), both read live from DS4 rather than guessed. (3) TPM1's Valuation Category - mandatory, not in the request, and TPM1 silently executes nothing without it; 'Mid-Year Valuation with Reset' was chosen as the conventional month-end (non-year-end) interim valuation. Confirmed by the requester on 2026-08-18 (after reuse on deals 160247, 160248, 160249) as the standing default for this row - do not re-ask.
